versos.grego: Καὶ ἐν τῷ συνπληροῦσθαι τὴν ἡμέραν τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς ἦσαν πάντες ὁμοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό·

controles.web: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.
controles.kjv: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
controles.livre: E ao se cumprir o dia de Pentecostes, estavam todos concordando no mesmo lugar.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο ἄφνω ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἦχος ὥσπερ φερομένης πνοῆς βιαίας καὶ ἐπλήρωσεν ὅλον τὸν οἶκον οὗ ἦσαν καθήμενοι,

controles.web: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
controles.kjv: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
controles.livre: E de repente houve um ruído do céu, como de um vento forte e violento, e encheu toda a casa onde eles estavam sentados.

versos.grego: καὶ ὤφθησαν αὐτοῖς διαμεριζόμεναι γλῶσσαι ὡσεὶ πυρός, καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐφ’ ἕνα ἕκαστον αὐτῶν,

controles.web: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.
controles.kjv: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
controles.livre: E foram vistas por eles línguas repartidas como que de fogo, e se pôs sobre cada um deles.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν πάντες Πνεύματος Ἁγίου, καὶ ἤρξαντο λαλεῖν ἑτέραις γλώσσαις καθὼς τὸ Πνεῦμα ἐδίδου ἀποφθέγγεσθαι αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.
controles.kjv: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
controles.livre: E eles foram todos cheios do Espírito Santo, e começaram a falar em outras línguas, conforme o Espírito lhes dava a discursarem.

versos.grego: Ἦσαν δὲ εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ κατοικοῦντες Ἰουδαῖοι, ἄνδρες εὐλαβεῖς ἀπὸ παντὸς ἔθνους τῶν ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν·

controles.web: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.
controles.kjv: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
controles.livre: E havia judeus que estavam morando em Jerusalém, homens devotos, de toda nação abaixo do céu.

versos.grego: γενομένης δὲ τῆς φωνῆς ταύτης συνῆλθεν τὸ πλῆθος καὶ συνεχύθη, ὅτι ἤκουον εἷς ἕκαστος τῇ ἰδίᾳ διαλέκτῳ λαλούντων αὐτῶν.

controles.web: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together, and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.
controles.kjv: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
controles.livre: E acontecendo esta voz, ajuntou-se a multidão; e ela estava confusa, porque cada um os ouvia falar em sua própria língua.

versos.grego: ἐξίσταντο δὲ καὶ ἐθαύμαζον λέγοντες Οὐχὶ ἰδοὺ πάντες οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ λαλοῦντες Γαλιλαῖοι;

controles.web: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?
controles.kjv: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galileans?
controles.livre: E todos estavam admirados, e se maravilhavam, dizendo uns aos outros: Ora, estes que estão falando, não são todos eles galileus?

versos.grego: καὶ πῶς ἡμεῖς ἀκούομεν ἕκαστος τῇ ἰδίᾳ διαλέκτῳ ἡμῶν ἐν ᾗ ἐγεννήθημεν,

controles.web: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?
controles.kjv: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
controles.livre: E como nós ouvimos cada um deles em nossa própria língua, na qual nascemos?

versos.grego: Πάρθοι καὶ Μῆδοι καὶ Ἐλαμεῖται, καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν, Ἰουδαίαν τε καὶ Καππαδοκίαν, Πόντον καὶ τὴν Ἀσίαν,

controles.web: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
controles.kjv: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
controles.livre: Partos, Medos, Elamitas, os habitantes da Mesopotâmia, da Judeia, Capadócia, Ponto, Ásia,

versos.grego: Φρυγίαν τε καὶ Παμφυλίαν, Αἴγυπτον καὶ τὰ μέρη τῆς Λιβύης τῆς κατὰ Κυρήνην, καὶ οἱ ἐπιδημοῦντες Ῥωμαῖοι,

controles.web: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
controles.kjv: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
controles.livre: Frígia, Panfília, Egito e regiões da Líbia perto de Cirene, e romanos estrangeiros, tanto judeus como prosélitos,

versos.grego: Ἰουδαῖοί τε καὶ προσήλυτοι, Κρῆτες καὶ Ἄραβες, ἀκούομεν λαλούντων αὐτῶν ταῖς ἡμετέραις γλώσσαις τὰ μεγαλεῖα τοῦ Θεοῦ;

controles.web: Cretans and Arabians: we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”
controles.kjv: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
controles.livre: Cretenses e Árabes, os ouvimos em nossas próprias línguas eles falarem das grandezas de Deus.

versos.grego: ἐξίσταντο δὲ πάντες καὶ διηποροῦντο, ἄλλος πρὸς ἄλλον λέγοντες Τί θέλει τοῦτο εἶναι;

controles.web: They were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying one to another, “What does this mean?”
controles.kjv: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
controles.livre: E todos estavam admirados e confusos, dizendo uns aos outros: O que isso quer dizer?

versos.grego: ἕτεροι δὲ διαχλευάζοντες ἔλεγον ὅτι Γλεύκους μεμεστωμένοι εἰσίν.

controles.web: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”
controles.kjv: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
controles.livre: E outros, ridicularizando, diziam: Eles estão cheios de vinho doce.

versos.grego: Σταθεὶς δὲ ὁ Πέτρος σὺν τοῖς ἕνδεκα ἐπῆρεν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπεφθέγξατο αὐτοῖς Ἄνδρες Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες Ἱερουσαλὴμ πάντες, τοῦτο ὑμῖν γνωστὸν ἔστω, καὶ ἐνωτίσασθε τὰ ῥήματά μου.

controles.web: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea, and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.
controles.kjv: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
controles.livre: Mas Pedro, pondo-se de pé com os onze, levantou sua voz, e lhes falou: Homens judeus, e todos os que habitais em Jerusalém, seja isto conhecido, e ouvi minhas palavras:

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ ὡς ὑμεῖς ὑπολαμβάνετε οὗτοι μεθύουσιν, ἔστιν γὰρ ὥρα τρίτη τῆς ἡμέρας,

controles.web: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.
controles.kjv: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
controles.livre: Porque estes não estão bêbados, como vós pensais, sendo ainda a terceira hora do dia.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ εἰρημένον διὰ τοῦ προφήτου Ἰωήλ

controles.web: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:
controles.kjv: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
controles.livre: Mas isto é o que foi dito por meio do profeta Joel:

versos.grego: Καὶ ἔσται ἐν ταῖς ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις, λέγει ὁ Θεός, ἐκχεῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ Πνεύματός μου ἐπὶ πᾶσαν σάρκα, καὶ προφητεύσουσιν οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες ὑμῶν, καὶ οἱ νεανίσκοι ὑμῶν ὁράσεις ὄψονται, καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ὑμῶν ἐνυπνίοις ἐνυπνιασθήσονται·

controles.web: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
controles.livre: E será nos últimos dias, diz Deus, que: Eu derramarei do meu Espírito sobre toda carne, e vossos filhos e filhas profetizarão, e vossos rapazes terão visões, e vossos velhos sonharão sonhos;

versos.grego: καίγε ἐπὶ τοὺς δούλους μου καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς δούλας μου ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐκχεῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ Πνεύματός μου, καὶ προφητεύσουσιν.

controles.web: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.
controles.kjv: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
controles.livre: E também sobre meus servos e sobre minhas servas, naqueles dias eu derramarei do meu Espírito, e profetizarão.

versos.grego: καὶ δώσω τέρατα ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἄνω καὶ σημεῖα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς κάτω, αἷμα καὶ πῦρ καὶ ἀτμίδα καπνοῦ.

controles.web: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.
controles.kjv: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
controles.livre: E darei milagres acima no céu, e sinais abaixo na terra; sangue, fogo, e vapor de fumaça;

versos.grego: ὁ ἥλιος μεταστραφήσεται εἰς σκότος καὶ ἡ σελήνη εἰς αἷμα, πρὶν ἐλθεῖν ἡμέραν Κυρίου τὴν μεγάλην καὶ ἐπιφανῆ.

controles.web: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.
controles.kjv: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:
controles.livre: O sol se converterá em trevas, e a lua em sangue, antes que venha o grande e notório dia do Senhor.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔσται πᾶς ὃς ἐὰν ἐπικαλέσηται τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου σωθήσεται.

controles.web: It will be, that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
controles.livre: E será que todo aquele que chamar ao nome do Senhor será salvo.

versos.grego: Ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλεῖται, ἀκούσατε τοὺς λόγους τούτους· Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζωραῖον, ἄνδρα ἀποδεδειγμένον ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς ὑμᾶς δυνάμεσι καὶ τέρασι καὶ σημείοις, οἷς ἐποίησεν δι’ αὐτοῦ ὁ Θεὸς ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν, καθὼς αὐτοὶ οἴδατε,

controles.web: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him in your midst, even as you yourselves know,
controles.kjv: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
controles.livre: Homens israelitas, ouvi estas palavras: Jesus o nazareno, homem aprovado por Deus entre vós, com maravilhas, milagres e sinais, que Deus fez por meio dele no meio de vós, assim como vós mesmos também sabeis;

versos.grego: τοῦτον τῇ ὡρισμένῃ βουλῇ καὶ προγνώσει τοῦ Θεοῦ ἔκδοτον διὰ χειρὸς ἀνόμων προσπήξαντες ἀνείλατε,

controles.web: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;
controles.kjv: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
controles.livre: Este, sendo entregue pelo determinado conselho e conhecimento prévio de Deus, sendo tomando, pelas mãos de injustos o crucificastes e matastes;

versos.grego: ὃν ὁ Θεὸς ἀνέστησεν λύσας τὰς ὠδῖνας τοῦ θανάτου, καθότι οὐκ ἦν δυνατὸν κρατεῖσθαι αὐτὸν ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.
controles.kjv: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
controles.livre: Ao qual Deus ressuscitou, tendo soltado as dores da morte; porque não era possível ele ser retido por ela;

versos.grego: Δαυεὶδ γὰρ λέγει εἰς αὐτόν Προορώμην τὸν Κύριον ἐνώπιόν μου διὰ παντός, ὅτι ἐκ δεξιῶν μού ἐστιν, ἵνα μὴ σαλευθῶ.

controles.web: For David says concerning him,  ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, For he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.
controles.kjv: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
controles.livre: Porque Davi diz sobre ele: Eu sempre via ao Senhor diante de mim, porque ele está à minha direita, para que eu não seja abalado.

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο ηὐφράνθη μου ἡ καρδία καὶ ἠγαλλιάσατο ἡ γλῶσσά μου, ἔτι δὲ καὶ ἡ σάρξ μου κατασκηνώσει ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι,

controles.web: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope;
controles.kjv: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
controles.livre: Por isso meu coração está contente, e minha língua se alegra, e até mesmo minha carne repousará em esperança.

versos.grego: ὅτι οὐκ ἐνκαταλείψεις τὴν ψυχήν μου εἰς Ἅιδην οὐδὲ δώσεις τὸν Ὅσιόν σου ἰδεῖν διαφθοράν.

controles.web: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.
controles.kjv: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
controles.livre: Pois tu não abandonarás minha alma no mundo dos mortos, nem entregarás a teu santo, para que veja corrupção.

versos.grego: ἐγνώρισάς μοι ὁδοὺς ζωῆς, πληρώσεις με εὐφροσύνης μετὰ τοῦ προσώπου σου.

controles.web: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’
controles.kjv: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
controles.livre: Tu tens me feito conhecer os caminhos da vida; tu me encherás de alegria com tua face.

versos.grego: Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί, ἐξὸν εἰπεῖν μετὰ παρρησίας πρὸς ὑμᾶς περὶ τοῦ πατριάρχου Δαυείδ, ὅτι καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν καὶ ἐτάφη, καὶ τὸ μνῆμα αὐτοῦ ἔστιν ἐν ἡμῖν ἄχρι τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης.

controles.web: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
controles.kjv: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
controles.livre: Homens irmãos, é lícito eu vos dizer abertamente sobre o patriarca Davi, que morreu, e foi sepultado, e a sepultura dele está conosco até o dia de hoje.

versos.grego: προφήτης οὖν ὑπάρχων καὶ εἰδὼς ὅτι ὅρκῳ ὤμοσεν αὐτῷ ὁ Θεὸς ἐκ καρποῦ τῆς ὀσφύος αὐτοῦ καθίσαι ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,
controles.kjv: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
controles.livre: Portanto, sendo ele profeta, e sabendo que Deus tinha lhe prometido com juramento que faria a um da sua descendência  se sentar no seu trono;

versos.grego: προϊδὼν ἐλάλησεν περὶ τῆς ἀναστάσεως τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὅτι οὔτε ἐνκατελείφθη εἰς Ἅιδην οὔτε ἡ σὰρξ αὐτοῦ εἶδεν διαφθοράν.

controles.web: he foreseeing this spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that neither was his soul left in Hades, nor did his flesh see decay.
controles.kjv: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
controles.livre: Vendo -o com antecedência, falou da ressurreição do Cristo, que a alma dele não foi abandonada no mundo dos mortos, nem a carne dele viu corrupção.

versos.grego: τοῦτον τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀνέστησεν ὁ Θεός, οὗ πάντες ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν μάρτυρες·

controles.web: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.
controles.kjv: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
controles.livre: A este Jesus Deus ressuscitou; do qual todos nós somos testemunhas.

versos.grego: τῇ δεξιᾷ οὖν τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑψωθεὶς τήν τε ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ Πνεύματος τοῦ Ἁγίου λαβὼν παρὰ τοῦ Πατρὸς ἐξέχεεν τοῦτο ὃ ὑμεῖς καὶ βλέπετε καὶ ἀκούετε.

controles.web: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this, which you now see and hear.
controles.kjv: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
controles.livre: Portanto, tendo sido exaltado à direita de Deus, e recebido do Pai a promessa do Espírito Santo, derramou isto que agora estais vendo e ouvindo.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ Δαυεὶδ ἀνέβη εἰς τοὺς οὐρανούς, λέγει δὲ αὐτός Εἶπεν Κύριος τῷ Κυρίῳ μου Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου,

controles.web: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself,  ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand,
controles.kjv: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
controles.livre: Porque Davi não subiu aos céus; mas sim, ele diz: Disse o Senhor a meu Senhor: Senta-te à minha direita,

versos.grego: ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου.

controles.web: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’
controles.kjv: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
controles.livre: Até que eu ponha teus inimigos por escabelo de teus pés.

versos.grego: ἀσφαλῶς οὖν γινωσκέτω πᾶς οἶκος Ἰσραὴλ ὅτι καὶ Κύριον αὐτὸν καὶ Χριστὸν ἐποίησεν ὁ Θεός, τοῦτον τὸν Ἰησοῦν ὃν ὑμεῖς ἐσταυρώσατε.

controles.web: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”
controles.kjv: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
controles.livre: Saiba então com certeza toda a casa de Israel, que Deus o fez Senhor e Cristo a este Jesus, que vós crucificastes.

versos.grego: Ἀκούσαντες δὲ κατενύγησαν τὴν καρδίαν, εἶπόν τε πρὸς τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τοὺς λοιποὺς ἀποστόλους Τί ποιήσωμεν, ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί;

controles.web: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
controles.kjv: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
controles.livre: E eles, ao ouvirem estas coisas ,foram afligidos como que perfurados de coração, e disseram a Pedro, e aos outros apóstolos: Que faremos, homens irmãos?

versos.grego: Πέτρος δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Μετανοήσατε, καὶ βαπτισθήτω ἕκαστος ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς ἄφεσιν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ὑμῶν, καὶ λήμψεσθε τὴν δωρεὰν τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος.

controles.web: Peter said to them, “Repent, and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
controles.kjv: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
controles.livre: E Pedro lhes disse: Arrependei-vos, e batize-se cada um de vós no nome de Jesus Cristo, para perdão dos pecados; e vós recebereis o dom do Espírito Santo.

versos.grego: ὑμῖν γάρ ἐστιν ἡ ἐπαγγελία καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις ὑμῶν καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς εἰς μακρὰν, ὅσους ἂν προσκαλέσηται Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν.

controles.web: For the promise is to you, and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”
controles.kjv: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.
controles.livre: Porque a promessa é para vós, e para vossos filhos, e para todos que ainda estão longe, a tantos quantos Deus, nosso Senhor, chamar.

versos.grego: ἑτέροις τε λόγοις πλείοσιν διεμαρτύρατο, καὶ παρεκάλει αὐτοὺς λέγων Σώθητε ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς τῆς σκολιᾶς ταύτης.

controles.web: With many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
controles.kjv: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
controles.livre: E com muitas outras palavras ele dava testemunho, e exortava, dizendo: Salvai-vos desta geração perversa!

versos.grego: οἱ μὲν οὖν ἀποδεξάμενοι τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ ἐβαπτίσθησαν, καὶ προσετέθησαν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ψυχαὶ ὡσεὶ τρισχίλιαι·

controles.web: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.
controles.kjv: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.
controles.livre: Então os que receberam a palavra dele de boa vontade foram batizados; e foram adicionados naquele dia quase três mil almas.

versos.grego: ἦσαν δὲ προσκαρτεροῦντες τῇ διδαχῇ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ τῇ κοινωνίᾳ, τῇ κλάσει τοῦ ἄρτου καὶ ταῖς προσευχαῖς.

controles.web: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
controles.kjv: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
controles.livre: E eles perseveravam na doutrina dos apóstolos, na comunhão, no partir do pão, e nas orações.

versos.grego: Ἐγίνετο δὲ πάσῃ ψυχῇ φόβος· πολλά δὲ τέρατα καὶ σημεῖα διὰ τῶν ἀποστόλων ἐγίνετο.

controles.web: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
controles.kjv: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
controles.livre: E houve temor em toda alma; e muitos milagres e sinais foram feitos pelos apóstolos.

versos.grego: πάντες δὲ οἱ πιστεύσαντες ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ εἶχον ἅπαντα κοινά,

controles.web: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.
controles.kjv: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
controles.livre: E todos os que criam estavam juntos, e tinham todas as coisas em comum.

versos.grego: καὶ τὰ κτήματα καὶ τὰς ὑπάρξεις ἐπίπρασκον καὶ διεμέριζον αὐτὰ πᾶσιν, καθότι ἄν τις χρείαν εἶχεν.

controles.web: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.
controles.kjv: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.
controles.livre: E eles vendiam suas propriedades e bens, e as repartiam com todos, conforme a necessidade que cada um tinha.

versos.grego: καθ’ ἡμέραν τε προσκαρτεροῦντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ, κλῶντές τε κατ’ οἶκον ἄρτον, μετελάμβανον τροφῆς ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει καὶ ἀφελότητι καρδίας,

controles.web: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,
controles.kjv: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
controles.livre: E perseverando a cada dia em concordância no Templo, e partindo o pão de casa em casa, comiam juntos com alegria e sinceridade de coração.

versos.grego: αἰνοῦντες τὸν Θεὸν καὶ ἔχοντες χάριν πρὸς ὅλον τὸν λαόν. ὁ δὲ Κύριος προσετίθει τοὺς σῳζομένους καθ’ ἡμέραν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό.

controles.web: praising God, and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.
controles.kjv: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
controles.livre: Louvando a Deus, e tendo graça, sendo do agrado de todo o povo. E a cada dia o Senhor acrescentava à igreja aqueles que estavam sendo salvos.
